title: MobileDreamer: Generative Sketch World Model for GUI Agent
abstract: arXiv:2601.04035v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents have shown strong potential in real-world automation and practical applications. However, most existing agents remain reactive, making decisions mainly from current screen, which limits their performance on long-horizon tasks. Building a world model from repeated interactions enables forecasting action outcomes and supports better decision making for mobile GUI agents. This is challenging because the model must predict post-action states with spatial awareness while remaining efficient enough for practical deployment. In this paper, we propose MobileDreamer, an efficient world-model-based lookahead framework to equip the GUI agents based on the future imagination provided by the world model. It consists of textual sketch world model and rollout imagination for GUI agent. translated_title: MobileDreamer：面向GUI智能体的生成式草图世界模型
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体在现实世界的自动化和实际应用中展现出了强大的潜力。然而，大多数现有智能体仍然是反应式的，主要基于当前屏幕做出决策，这限制了它们在长时程任务上的表现。通过反复交互构建世界模型能够预测动作的结果，从而为移动GUI智能体提供更好的决策支持。这极具挑战性，因为该模型必须在具备空间感知能力的前提下预测动作后的状态，同时还要保持足够高的效率以满足实际部署的需求。在本文中，我们提出了MobileDreamer，一个高效的基于世界模型的前瞻框架，它利用世界模型提供的未来想象来增强GUI智能体的能力。该框架由文本草图世界模型和面向GUI智能体的推演想象两部分组成。文本草图世界模型通过一个学习过程将数字图像转化为关键的任务相关草图，从而预测动作后的状态，并且……
tldr: 提出了MobileDreamer框架，通过将屏幕图像转化为任务相关的文本草图来构建世界模型，预测动作后的状态，为移动GUI智能体提供基于未来想象的前瞻式决策能力，兼顾空间感知与部署效率。
en_tdlr: MobileDreamer is an efficient world-model-based lookahead framework that transforms screen images into task-related textual sketches to forecast post-action states, enabling mobile GUI agents to make better decisions through future imagination while remaining practical for deployment.
